observations: Photo 0: a complete V-type engine with a long automatic transmission bolted to its back, lying on the ground in an open-air workshop yard.
Photo 0: the transmission is a long longitudinal (rear-wheel-drive layout) automatic gearbox with its tail housing at the bottom of the frame; cooler lines run along it.
Photo 0: engine carries wiring harness, intake and accessories; heavy dirt and oil residue on both engine and gearbox.
Photo 0: a loose metal bracket or mount lies on the ground at bottom left; a person in a workshop shirt is working behind the engine.
Photo 0: a watermark across the gearbox reads something like 'GEARUP IN...', a dealer's mark; no transmission ID tag, model code or VIN is readable.
Nothing in the photo shows the vehicle make or year; the photo shows engine and gearbox together while the text offers a gearbox.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (longitudinal, for a V8 pickup/SUV)
read_from: photo 0 transmission bolted behind a V8 engine

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a longitudinal automatic gearbox on a V8, but no transmission tag, model code or VIN is readable to confirm GMC Sierra fitment or year.
Origin cannot be seen in a photo; no import documents or tags shown.
No clip of the gearbox running or shifting, no fluid sample or test record.

risks.risk: Gearbox may be faulty (slipping, no reverse, failed solenoid pack or torque converter).
risks.proof: Clip of the engine and gearbox running on a stand or in a vehicle, shifting through park, reverse, drive and gears.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, a core for rebuild

risks.risk: It may not be the GMC Sierra V8 gearbox claimed (different model or year range, different price and fitment).
risks.proof: Close photo of the transmission ID tag or stamped code on the case.
risks.if_unproven: as the cheapest V8 truck automatic gearbox, fitment unconfirmed

risks.risk: Unclear whether the engine shown is included or only the gearbox is sold.
risks.proof: Seller to state what is in the sale and a photo of the gearbox alone, separated.
risks.if_unproven: as gearbox only, engine not included

risks.risk: Cracked bell housing, damaged pan or missing torque converter.
risks.proof: Photos of the bell housing with the converter in place and the underside oil pan.
risks.if_unproven: as needing converter and case repair

risks.risk: Burnt or contaminated fluid showing internal wear.
risks.proof: Photo of fluid drained from the pan or dipstick on white paper.

proof_requests: Close photo of the transmission ID tag or case code.
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting through all positions.
Seller to confirm whether the engine is included, with a photo of the gearbox alone.
Photo of the fluid on white paper and of the bell housing with the torque converter.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows a used longitudinal automatic gearbox behind a V8, so it can be priced by type at its worst case: gearbox only, not working, fitment to GMC Sierra unconfirmed until the ID tag and a running clip are shown.
